recap.text: Framed photograph of Bea and Brad comes out of Donut's fan box at the pub, a square picture from Bea's Instagram, the one that made Carl break up with her. In it Bea laughs in a bikini on her ex-boyfriend Brad_the_Chad69's lap, her arm draped round his shoulder. Donut shows everyone and tells Mongo it is his grandmother; Mongo hisses until Donut admonishes him. Mordecai watches Carl, who finds it doesn't bother him.

Donut lays out the room. The bathroom goes in the corner, and Carl has to put the cat tree beside the Ultra-Stabilized Bed, whose semi-transparent mattress looks like clear Jell-O. The framed picture of Bea goes on a small table next to the bed. Donut tells Carl to get in bed, and Mongo too, because they are all tired. Carl points out that he has his own room now.

Carl clicks off a screen of viewer comments, Donut snuggled in his arm. Her candle sits by the screen, and beside it stands the photograph of Bea and Brad, which she has never put away. Carl decides that's okay. He pushes the photograph aside, pulls out a lighter and lights the candle, and the scent of home fills the room.

beats.headline: Voted in by the fans
beats.text: The first fan boxes open at the pub, and Donut's holds a small, framed picture. Of Bea. The square photo comes straight from her Instagram, and it is the one that made Carl break up with her: Bea in a bikini, laughing, on her ex-boyfriend's lap with her arm draped round his shoulder, taking the selfie. Brad, handle Brad_the_Chad69. Donut is thrilled and shows everyone. Look, Mongo, it's your grandmother! Mordecai watches Carl, not the picture. It doesn't bother Carl, and that feels almost monumental. Mongo hisses at it a couple of times until Donut admonishes him.
beats.gist: Donut's fan box holds a framed photo of Bea on Brad's lap, and Carl feels nothing.

beats.headline: By the bed
beats.text: Donut lays the room out. The bathroom goes in the corner; Carl has to put the cat tree beside the Ultra-Stabilized Bed, which has a semi-transparent mattress like clear Jell-O, and then the framed picture of Bea on a small table next to the bed. Then she tells Carl to get in bed, Mongo too, because they are all tired. Carl points out that he has his own room now.
beats.gist: Donut arranges the room and puts the cat tree and Bea's picture by the bed.

beats.headline: Never put away
beats.text: Carl clicks a screen of viewer comments off, with Donut snuggled in his arm. Her candle sits right by the screen, and beside it the photograph of Bea and Brad, which she has never put away. That's okay. Carl pushes the photo aside, pulls a lighter and lights the candle, and the scent of home fills the room.
beats.gist: Donut keeps Bea and Brad's photograph by her candle, and Carl pushes it aside to light the candle.
